title: library thumbnail and clip stats

commit.merge_subject: merge: library thumbnail and clip stats

description:
The Library row now carries the owner's requested rich metadata
(owner request 2026-11-11 section 1): thumbnail at the LEFT, then
the clip's file name, then the recorded resolution and duration.

What:
- Each row leads with a 64 dp thumbnail: the persisted first-frame
  PNG from the generation pass (neutral develop, the owner accepts
  the dark look), cropped to fill inside the theme's small shape
  over a surfaceVariant placeholder. Decoding happens once per
  composition on Dispatchers.IO through produceState, so a fast
  scroll cancels stranded decodes and never re-develops RAW.
- LibraryRowModel (pure, JVM-tested) builds the supporting line
  "3840x2160 . 0:12" from the recorded stats: each part hides when
  unknown (0x0 hides the resolution, 0 us hides the duration),
  nothing is ever faked, and the row falls back to the kind line
  while the record is still unprobed. The line rende
changed: feat: thumbnail generation and stat backfill
feat: library rows with thumbnail and stats
